items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: But he's a good buddy. Very good buddy, racially

ctx.x: Quiet. You could hear a pin drop. Quiet. And I'd make this great big -- I wouldn't say error -- boner. Right in the midst of a beautiful song, boy. See playing with 4 strings is harder than a lot of people think. Because you -- I can't go no further than my D string. If I had a D flat I gotta leave that top & come jump back. And it would make me miss a lot of notes, I'd have to do too much jumpin' about -- I can't go across the board, as you might say. And it keeps me goin' up and down, up and down, so, but can't…

can do it. One fella could do fairly good at this. Took lessons from me a while. Excellent guitar player, James Charillo. I'm quite sure you know him. He could do it. I learned him all my tricks. But he's a good buddy. Very good buddy, racially
